Subject: Orange Team onboarding credits — eligibility question

Hi Ben,

Quick question — our Orange Team accelerator cohort is kicking off next month and we'd like to understand whether the promotional onboarding credits from our partner package can be pooled across the cohort projects, or if they have to be assigned to a single account. If pooling is possible, what operational steps do you need from us to get them activated (MA plan, expected consumption, legal ok)?

We're trying to avoid applicants hitting usage caps in week 1 — a handful of teams will be prototyping with higher token volumes. Legal has already signed the standard MSA; I can share a copy if needed.

Appreciate any guidance; happy to jump on a 20-min call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Program Director, Orange Startup Accelerator
Samantha Green | Orange Startup, Inc.
programs@orangestartup.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@orangestartup.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orange Team onboarding credits — eligibility question

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and congrats on the cohort launch. Short answer: we can enable a cohort-level promo activation, but we usually require a lightweight mutual action (MA) plan + a security attestation from the teams to qualify for pooled credits. Operationally I need:

- Confirmed HubSpot deal id or PO (if available)
- Expected average daily token volume per pilot (or monthly total estimate)
- Which projects will use the credits (team names / primary contact)
- Confirmation there's no regulated PII/workload that requires Private deployment

If that looks reasonable I'd propose a 3-month pilot activation mapped to the deal. I'll prepare an MA plan template showing milestones (onboarding, usage review, conversion discussion to Dedicated capacity). I attached the MA plan template and an onboarding sheet that lists technical and billing checkpoints.

If you'd prefer we can also do a gated activation (smaller initial bucket + bump on milestone). Let me know which you prefer and share any files you already have. I'll queue this for ad-hoc promo approval internally once I have the details.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

[Attachments referenced: Orange_Team_MAPlan.pdf (proposal template), Orange_Team_Onboarding_Sheet.xlsx (ops checklist)]

LAUREN / IRENE — forwarding inbound from Samantha (Orange Team). They want a pooled promo activation tied to HUB-45822 starting July 1. Ask: 3-month pilot, ~3M tokens/mo (peaks), no regulated PII. Can we approve a one-time promo activation equivalent to $25K USD (pre-quant): covers initial three months with a usage cap and automatic expiry?

Why this matters: cohort has multiple founders who will convert to committed Reserved capacity if pilot goes well — it's a partner-sourced cohort and quick onboarding increases conversion velocity.

I attached the MA plan template and the onboarding sheet — I'd like to set this up as gated (initial bucket + bump on milestone) unless operations prefers flat promo. Also flagging deal id: HUB-45822 and link to the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/45822

Requested internal checks:
- LAUREN: pricing approval + confirm promo accounting pathway (is this treated as deferrable credit or discount?)
- IRENE: quick security attestation required from cohort leads, and SOC2 evidence if you want it before activation.

Can you reply with approvals or required modifications? If yes I'll send MA plan to Samantha for signature.

Thanks,
Ben

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jun 2028 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orange Team onboarding credits — request for cohort-level activation

Ben — I support a limited promo activation but prefer a staged commit: approve up to 60% of the requested value up front (so $15K equivalent), with the remainder contingent on a milestone review at day 45 (usage + conversion intent). Treat the up-front portion as a promo credit (not revenue deferral) for accounting simplicity — ops can process as marketing credit against HUB-45822.

Require outreach to finance/ops to confirm the ledger treatment; please include the exact promo SKU you plan to apply so they can reconcile. Also confirm expiration date (auto-expire after 90 days).

- Lauren
